verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime's API covers the full debit card lifecycle (issue, activate, suspend, deactivate). It supports virtual cards and card fulfillment, which implies physical cards, and cards can be issued to account holders and authorized users. Spend control comes through a real-time Card Auth Loop that accepts or rejects authorizations, backed by decline reasons and ATM network access. Missing for 10: any evidence of digital wallet support (Apple Pay/Google Pay provisioning), explicit configurable spend limits or merchant/MCC controls beyond the custom auth loop, explicit physical-card ordering details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
